value_innovation_text: Agriculture is constantly evolving, and we're proud to lead that evolution. We're always looking for new ways to help farmers improve — through cutting-edge technology and thoughtful design.
timeline_2022_text: Launched the full E20 ethanol-compatible product range — sustainable, low-emission, future-ready machines for Indian farmers.
vision_text: To empower modern farmers with innovative, reliable, and sustainable agricultural solutions that enhance productivity and ease farming challenges.
timeline_2025_text: Over two and a half lakh farmers across India and neighbouring countries now rely on Krishitek machinery every season.
founder_quote: "Farming is not just a profession — it's a way of life."
about_para_4: Our farm machinery and equipment are designed to withstand the tough demands of the farming landscape, making us the go-to choice for farmers — not only in India but also in neighbouring countries and Africa. When you choose Krishitek, you're getting a partner who's committed to your success.
about_para_2: Our name, Krishitek, embodies our ethos of blending the best of agriculture and technology to empower farmers to achieve better yields, higher productivity, and economic stability. With a comprehensive range of high-quality power reaper machines, power weeders, and mini tillers, we are dedicated to helping farmers achieve their full potential.
about_para_3: Since our inception in 2012, we have been at the forefront of the farm mechanisation revolution, introducing innovative products that address the needs of farmers. We manufacture all our products in India with a focus on quality, durability, and reliability, adhering to stringent quality standards.
value_integrity_text: We believe in doing the right thing, always. Trust is the cornerstone of every relationship — from the equipment we source to the way we treat our employees, integrity guides everything we do.
value_excellence_text: Excellence is a journey, not a destination. We're committed to continuous improvement in everything — our machines, our processes, and our people.
timeline_2018_text: Expanded to 500+ trusted dealer partners across 22+ Indian states, bringing Krishitek closer to every farmer.
timeline_2015_text: Our flagship self-propelled power reaper enters the market, changing the way Indian farmers harvest paddy and wheat.
about_hero_title:
Built for Indian Farmers.
Engineered for the Future.
mission_text: Deliver advanced, user-friendly agricultural machinery tailored to diverse farming needs, backed by exceptional customer support and continuous innovation.
value_sustain_text: The choices we make today will shape the world for generations to come. We implement waste-reduction strategies and utilise eco-friendly materials to safeguard our planet.
value_relationships_text: Agriculture is a community. By building trust and working collaboratively with customers, partners, and employees, we achieve more together than we ever could alone.
timeline_2012_text: Krishitek Industries Pvt. Ltd. is established with a mission to bring precision machinery to Indian farms.
about_hero_sub: Since 2012, Krishitek has been at the forefront of farm mechanisation — designing, manufacturing, and delivering precision agricultural machinery right here in India.
about_para_1: Krishitek Industries Pvt. Ltd. is a pioneering manufacturer of farm machinery and equipment that blends the art of agriculture with cutting-edge technology, thereby helping in sustainable farming. We're a company driven by a passion for innovation and a deep-rooted respect for the farming community.
values_intro_text: At Krishitek, we don't just believe in producing top-quality machines — we believe in cultivating a culture that values integrity, innovation, and sustainability.
